name: alpha6-golden-clouds
js: (() => {const a=window.__CITY_APP,c=a.renderer.contextNode.value.getClouds();if(!c||c.frame<1)throw new Error('Cloud simulation is inactive');for(const key of ['shapeTexture','shapeDetailTexture','localWeatherTexture','turbulenceTexture'])if(!(c[key]?.image?.width>1))throw new Error('Missing cloud texture '+key);document.getElementById('locate-prompt').hidden=true;console.log('[ride-check] alpha6 clouds active '+JSON.stringify({frame:c.frame,time:c.time,preset:c.qualityPreset,shape:[c.shapeTexture.image.width,c.shapeTexture.image.height,c.shapeTexture.image.depth]}));})()
